summary: Dated vertebrate trees (VertLife), the Open Tree synthetic tree, global occurrence records (GBIF, 3.7 billion georeferenced), plant naturalization lists (GloNAF) and fossil occurrences (PBDB) are open. None supplies the area of each clade's region of origin, which the claim needs; island-versus-continent diversification data exist only for single clades such as passerines.
next_step: Define area of origin from published ancestral-range reconstructions for a chosen group (e.g. mammals or birds), join to VertLife trees and GBIF-derived range sizes, then pre-register the comparison.
obstacles_confirmed: Clade origin area is not tabulated in any resource fetched.
Area, isolation and sampling effort are confounded in occurrence data.
Open Tree web landing did not respond; API did.
